title: Ed calling notes: learning keys on clarinet
summary: Harry's brother Ed called out piano notes, so Harry thought in transposed names, which Emmett Hardy later corrected.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I was playing the piano, you know, my brother, he and I would play together and he would call out the notes, the piano notes.
Like A, B or B flat?

E flat, B flat, F and for quite a while I would say, which really was my G, I'd call it F, which was my F, I'd call it E flat because I thought Ed was right. So when I first started playing with Emmet Hardy, he knew the difference. So he'd say F, no, E flat for you, but it's really F, but you know it as E flat. So we'd play the tune, I'd play the harmony to him, you know, whatever he'd play.
